name: reading-scope-misses-duplicate-implementation-and-plan-tests-ineffective-as-runtime-user-fails-planning-rounds
description: Athena's reading names one implementation of a mechanism when the same code is duplicated elsewhere in the scope the request names, and the plan's tests use permissions or setup (such as write bits) that the real runtime user (root) ignores, so the critic finds both only after the last planning round.
